notice:
Vapor / VGUI2 libadwaita setup:
  In KDE System Settings > Colors & Themes > Application Style, select
  Vapor, Vapor-dark or VGUI2Classic as the GNOME/GTK theme and click Apply.
  Save your work, then log out of KDE Plasma and log back in to activate
  the matching libadwaita colors. Repeat after changing GTK themes.

  To apply without logging out, run as your normal user:
    vapor-libadwaita auto
  Then fully close and reopen GTK 4/libadwaita applications.
  A previous explicit disable is preserved; use vapor-libadwaita enable
  if you want to re-enable it.
